title: Purposeful but not high-quality.
text:
Purposeful but not high-quality.. After about a month of use one of them started to tear away at the top; part of the clear plastic started to remove itself from teh black fabric. We keep these under the bed with very minimal movement against them; the bed is high enough so that it doesn't touch the storage bags at all. We have hardwood floors, and the ottoman against the bed and the bed itslef has metal legs; I don't think these are the culprits, but I'm not sure why else the plastic would start to tear away.
We use them to store seasonal sheets and they're fine for that; the plastic tearing itslef away doesn't prevent me from using them. The tear is only a few inches long, and there's only one (so far).
